sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Bio Amphibian

system.description:
Emulating the ability of your Bio-Pet, you are able to convert your chakra into a sticky oil, and spit it in bullet like bursts. Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack, against a creature you can see in range, dealing 4d6 cold damage and forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid being covered in the oil. On a failure, they gain a rank of Doused, and their speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Doused by +1. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can change the shape of the oil burst into a Self (30-Foot cone), originating from you. If you do, then forgo the attack, and all creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the jutsu’s damage and conditions and effects on a failure. On a success, the affected creatures only take half damage. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Doused by +1.
